title: Welcome to AI Game Dev!
author: fisj
selftext:
Interested in using AI to make games? Interested in exploring the bleeding edge of new models and talking with other game developers? You're at the right place.

The Stable Diffusion and other model specific channels are quite noisy. A lot of good stuff that might be well suited to AI Game dev gets lost. So lets post interesting Generative AI stuff here thats more applicable to game development.

Our [discord server](https://discord.gg/6yrzsDJVGp) is the best place to chat about these topics in greater detail. So jump on in!

Other links and recommended resources:

* [https://old.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion](https://old.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion)
* [https://old.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusionInfo/](https://old.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusionInfo/)
* [https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/](https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/)
* [https://www.reddit.com/r/GPT3/](https://www.reddit.com/r/GPT3/)
